reviews.title: I wish I didn’t LOVE this serum as much as I do!!! Makes anyone look like they have “GOOD GENES”!
reviews.body: I wish I could afford to bathe in Good Genes! The formula is pretty basic (lactic acid, licorice), but this non-irritating lotion literally restored glowing radiance to my very dry, dull, probably perimenopausal skin IMMEDIATELY. You get that immediate gratification, and with continued use, a more even toned appearance with less prominent fine lines and wrinkles…If you’re over 40 and haven’t been introduced to the magic of lactic acid (and don’t want to bother with peels) you should really try this one. Easy to apply, no-rinse, daily lotion can easily fit into any routine (no matter how lazy or intricate).  I just wish the regular price was a little more reasonable. I guess wait for a sale, and then stock up! I hate that I love it so much…Read moreRead less

reviews.title: After a long career trying out every beauty serum, this is one of my must-haves
reviews.body: I don't generally consider myself to be a superstitious person, and yet I have bought this (let's be honest:) absurdly expensive exfoliating serum more than a dozen times over the past several years. There's just something about it that makes me feel—nay believe—that a big part of my having much clearer, better-textured skin than I did ten years ago is at least to some extent attributable to this serum.First of all, this just feels very, very good to use. The product is neither heavy/greasy, nor is it overly thin or watery - you can almost feel it sinking into your skin as you apply it. Unlike many chemical exfoliants (glycolic acids have generally been my go-tos), I've never experienced any stinging or even temporary redness after applying this—even in mid-winter, when my face is otherwise dull, flaky, and mercurial. Instead, from time to time I'll feel a not at all unpleasant gentle tingling that ebbs away in seconds. Finally, it has an almost imperceptible pleasant, wholly natural-seeming scent.All in all, as a chronic skincare overspender, I very much believe that this product, moreso than any other I've tried in my endless quest to find the holy grail of facial maintenance, has been *extremely* thoughtfully formulated.For me, the only downside is how almost insultingly expensive this product is; however, it is a beauty serum, not a bottle of ketchup, so hate the game, not the player. Plus, if you use a single pump each day (which is absolutely adequate), a bottle will last long enough to give you time to get over your consternation over how much it cost. Of course, then there's the fresh dismay over how much you'll have to shell out for another bottle...Read moreRead less

Together with skin brightening licorice, this super-concentrated treatment visually reduces the look of dark spots and discoloration caused by exposure to the sun, for naturally brighter, even-toned skin.
Clinically tested and proven to improve the appearance of lines and wrinkles in just 3 minutes; and dark spots in 8 weeks.
